description: Figure 5 illustrates the proportion of SDPA output values below a threshold, presented for different conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 24, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Sparsity Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Three lines are displayed: a dashed orange line representing sparsity ratio after gate, starting at approximately 0.78 at layer 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.12 at layer 24; a dashed blue line representing sparsity ratio after average gate, starting at approximately 0.68 at layer 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.08 at layer 24; and a solid yellow line representing sparsity ratio before gate, starting at approximately 0.63 at layer 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.06 at layer 24.
